Hi Alice — great to hear Contoso is ready. I pulled together a short bootcamp-style checklist below and attached a spreadsheet you can use to track items between teams. I also copied our marketplace PM (Jonas) and AE (Ben) to coordinate co-sell next steps.

High-level publisher tenant activation (expected 1–3 business days if artifacts ready):
1) Create/enroll publisher tenant in Partner Center — Contoso to confirm primary account owner + contact.
2) Verify identity (email domain + MPN enrollment if applicable).
3) Activate publisher profile and agree to commerce terms.
4) Provide technical contact and a test subscription for offer validation.

Technical validation gates we commonly see (please have these available):
- Offer package: SaaS application descriptor (SaaS Fulfillment plan) or VM image manifest (VM offers).
- URI endpoints for the SaaS callback (redirects, webhook endpoints) and sample credentials for test tenants.
- Service Principal + least-privilege role used for marketplace provisioning (AppID + secret OR certificate).
- Container image in ACR with public pull or temporary auth for validation teams; manifest must be signed if you follow policy.
- Telemetry/health endpoints and a smoke test route returning 200 for a simple request.
- Privacy and data handling statement (links preferred) for the offer listing.

Attachments and next steps:
- Attached: azure-publisher-checklist-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet with gate checklist and owner columns).
- Please fill in the columns in the spreadsheet for each gate and share access to any test resources we should use.
- Proposed bootcamp: 30 minutes for a walkthrough + 30 minutes for validation run-through. Available windows next week: Tue/Wed mornings PST.

Jonas — can you confirm any additional validation items the Azure marketplace validation team will demand (packaging nuances, rate-limit testing, etc.)? Ben — I’ll loop you into co-sell readiness once we confirm publisher account ownership.

Thanks,

Hi Alice / Soojin — quick technical addendum from the marketplace side before the bootcamp:

1) Offer packaging details: For a SaaS offer we ask for an offer manifest (publisher-<id>-offer.json) and a SaaS fulfillment URL that responds to the purchase/validation handshake. If you’re using a reverse-proxy or gateway, include the exact hostnames and an allowlist for the validator IPs.

2) Image/Container expectations: If you publish a container-backed SaaS plan, push images to ACR in a stable tag (no latest), include image digest, and provide a pull role for the validator service principal. For VM images we run an automated boot test in the validation environment — ensure cloud-init or custom script extensions are included.

3) Security scan / compliance: Marketplace validation may request a short vulnerability scan report for the image or a statement that you run routine scans. For SaaS, provide a short note on data retention and user data separation.

4) Test accounts: Provide at least one test user (email + password) with a small example org in staging. We use this for functional smoke tests.

Operational checks we will run in the bootcamp (so the validation bucket is green):
- Smoke test of acquisition flow (purchase->fulfillment).
- Token exchange flow if using AAD/OAuth.
- Health endpoint and telemetry verification.
- Billing metering hook if you plan to use usage-based metrics.

I attached a screenshot from a recent tenant activation that shows the Partner Center menu path — it can help when you’re assigning roles (Publishing settings > Offers).

Looking forward to the bootcamp — Tue 09:00 PST works for me.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Marketplace Product Manager
